name: amarel-vscode
description: Amarel VS Code Skill for Rutgers Amarel: set up VS Code Remote-SSH and fix the GLIBC 2.28 error. Works with Claude Code, Codex, or no LLM.

interface.shortDescription: Set up VS Code Remote-SSH on Rutgers Amarel and fix the GLIBC 2.28 error.
interface.longDescription: Guides you through setting up VS Code Remote-SSH against the Rutgers Amarel HPC cluster (CentOS 7, glibc 2.17). Installs a custom-glibc 2.28 sysroot into your $HOME on Amarel so VS Code Server 1.99+ runs there, wires SSH key auth, deploys the sysroot, edits ~/.bashrc, applies the VS Code Server extension-signature workaround, fixes the Source Control 'no Git repository' failure by pointing VS Code at a modern git, and optionally wires up GitHub auth. Idempotent and safe to re-run. Requires Rutgers VPN and a valid Amarel account.
defaultPrompt: Use the amarel-vscode-setup skill to set up VS Code Remote-SSH on Amarel.
Use the amarel-vscode-setup skill to fix the GLIBC 2.28 error on Amarel.
Use the amarel-vscode-setup skill to fix the Source Control 'no Git repository' error on Amarel.
